com.ibm.cos.v2.services.s3.model

Class AddLegalHoldRequest

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.core.SdkRequest
      • com.ibm.cos.v2.awscore.AwsRequest
        • com.ibm.cos.v2.services.s3.model.S3Request
          • com.ibm.cos.v2.services.s3.model.AddLegalHoldRequest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SdkPojo, ToCopyableBuilder<AddLegalHoldRequest.Builder,AddLegalHoldRequest>

    public class AddLegalHoldRequest
extends S3Request
implements SdkPojo, ToCopyableBuilder<AddLegalHoldRequest.Builder,AddLegalHoldRequest>
    Request object representing the parameters required to add a legal hold on an object in IBM Cloud Object Storage.

    A legal hold prevents the object from being modified or deleted until explicitly released. This model wraps bucket, key, and optional legal hold identifier metadata.
